name: Tip & Bill Splitter
tagline: Calculate tip and split the bill among a group
description: Calculate the tip amount for any bill and split the total among multiple people. Shows tip amount, total per person, and a breakdown for easy reference. Works in any currency.

expert_defs.name: tip_calculator_compute
expert_defs.description: Calculates tip and splits bill among people. Params: bill (total bill amount), tip_percent (tip percentage, default 15), people (number of people, default 2). Returns JSON with output_type json.
code: result = {'bill': b, 'tip_percent': tp, 'tip_amount': tip, 'total': total, 'people': n, 'per_person': per_person, 'tip_per_person': tip_per_person}

conceptTexts: Plugin: Tip & Bill Splitter (id: tip-calculator). Expert tip_calculator_compute calculates tip and splits bills. Params: bill (amount), tip_percent (default 15), people (default 2). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {bill, tip_amount, total, per_person, tip_per_person}}.
